name: High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at least 100 hours over the school year in hospital departments, with one 3-hour shift a week.
who_can_apply: High school students at least 15 years old who are starting 9th, 10th, 11th or 12th grade in the 2026-2027 school year. Spots are limited and applicants are interviewed.
duration: At least 100 hours in the school year; 1 to 3 shifts of 3 hours per week
deadline_text: Page says applications are closed. It lists a deadline of July 30, 2026 and also an application window opening June 1, 2027 (notices by July 29, 2027, interviews Aug 2 to 13, 2027). The dates conflict, so confirm.
how_to_apply: Online application when the window opens, then an interview. Contact Kimberly Morrow, Volunteer Coordinator, 909-579-6794 (8 a.m. to 4 p.m.).
notes: CONFIRM FIRST: closed now and the page lists conflicting dates. Non-graduating volunteers who finish 100 hours can return the next year.
